description: Cloud cost and orphan-resource reporting — read-only AWS, DigitalOcean and Linode adapters, deterministic detection, and a self-contained HTML report

scripts.name: fetch_aws
scripts.description: AWS read-only cost and inventory adapter that fetches costs from Cost Explorer and resources across all opted-in regions, normalizes them, and emits JSON artifacts.

args.name: output_dir
args.description: Directory the normalized cost and inventory artifacts are written to; the pipeline convention is a per-provider tree (output/aws)

args.name: period
args.description: YYYY-MM (default: current UTC month)

args.name: endpoint_url
args.description: Override every AWS endpoint (offline tests point this at a local stub)

args.name: timeout
args.description: Per-request timeout in seconds

args.name: max_attempts
args.description: botocore retry attempts per API call

scripts.name: fetch_do
scripts.description: DigitalOcean read-only cost and inventory adapter that fetches billing data and resource snapshot, normalizes them, and emits JSON artifacts.

args.name: output_dir
args.description: Directory the normalized cost and inventory artifacts are written to; the pipeline convention is a per-provider tree (output/digitalocean)

args.name: period
args.description: YYYY-MM (default: current UTC month)

args.name: api_base
args.description: DigitalOcean API base URL

args.name: timeout
args.description: Per-request timeout in seconds

args.name: max_retries
args.description: Retry attempts per API call

args.name: retry_base_delay
args.description: Base delay in seconds for exponential retry backoff

scripts.name: fetch_linode
scripts.description: Linode read-only cost and inventory adapter that fetches the settled invoice and its items, sweeps instances, volumes, IPs, NodeBalancers and images, prices them from the unauthenticated types endpoints, normalizes them, and emits JSON artifacts.

args.name: output_dir
args.description: Directory the normalized cost and inventory artifacts are written to; the pipeline convention is a per-provider tree (output/linode)

args.name: period
args.description: YYYY-MM, the month the figures COVER. Left unset the adapter selects the newest settled invoice, so a snapshot is structurally one month behind — Linode publishes no preview invoice. A period no invoice covers is reported, never invented

args.name: api_base
args.description: Linode API base URL. Constructed here and never taken from LINODE_CLI_API_HOST/_VERSION/_SCHEME, which redirect where a credential is sent

args.name: timeout
args.description: Per-request timeout in seconds

args.name: max_retries
args.description: Retry attempts per API call

args.name: retry_base_delay
args.description: Base delay in seconds for exponential retry backoff

scripts.name: detect_orphans
scripts.description: Deterministic orphan detection engine that applies heuristic rules to a normalized inventory to identify orphaned resources with confidence scores and evidence.

args.name: inventory
args.description: Normalized inventory JSON (from an adapter)

args.name: output_dir
args.description: Directory the orphan-candidates artifact is written to; keep it alongside the inventory it was derived from

args.name: reference_date
args.description: YYYY-MM-DD or ISO-8601 timestamp; age rules are evaluated against this (default: the inventory's generated_at)

args.name: snapshot_age_days
args.description: Snapshot orphan threshold N in days (default: 30)

scripts.name: detect_optimization_signals
scripts.description: Exploratory AWS optimization signals over S3, ECR, and Secrets Manager — missing S3 and ECR lifecycle policies, incomplete multipart uploads, empty buckets, untagged-image accumulation, and unused secrets — emitted as a separate signals/denied/warnings artifact that the core report pipeline never reads.

args.name: output_dir
args.description: Directory optimization_signals_aws_{period}.json is written to; the pipeline convention is a per-provider tree (output/aws)

args.name: period
args.description: YYYY-MM (default: current UTC month)

args.name: reference_date
args.description: YYYY-MM-DD or ISO-8601; age rules run against this (default: now)

args.name: endpoint_url
args.description: Override every AWS endpoint (offline tests point this at a local stub)

args.name: old_image_days
args.description: Age in days past which an untagged ECR image counts toward the accumulation signal

args.name: secret_unused_days
args.description: Days since last access past which a secret is reported unused

args.name: s3_size_lookback_days
args.description: CloudWatch lookback window in days for bucket size and object-count metrics

args.name: timeout
args.description: Per-request timeout in seconds

args.name: max_attempts
args.description: botocore retry attempts per API call

scripts.name: compose_report_data
scripts.description: Merges normalized cost, inventory, and orphan artifacts into a single report-data JSON file with service totals, month-on-month delta, tag coverage, and confidence-banded orphans.

args.name: cost
args.description: Normalized cost snapshot. Repeatable on the command line (once per provider, paired positionally with --inventory and --orphans); this form supplies one. Cannot be combined with --input-dir

args.name: inventory
args.description: Normalized inventory. Repeatable on the command line, paired positionally with --cost and --orphans; this form supplies one. Cannot be combined with --input-dir

args.name: orphans
args.description: Orphan candidates. Repeatable on the command line, paired positionally with --cost and --inventory; this form supplies one. Cannot be combined with --input-dir

args.name: input_dir
args.description: Group every normalized artifact in this directory into per-provider bundles. Use this instead of --cost/--inventory/--orphans; at least one of the two forms is required

args.name: output_dir
args.description: Directory report_data_{period}.json is written to

args.name: history_dir
args.description: Persisted monthly cost snapshots, used for the month-on-month delta. Give each provider its own tree (history/aws, history/digitalocean); left blank the script falls back to the shared cloudcost/history, where the prior-month lookup sums every provider's snapshot into one prior_total

args.name: period
args.description: YYYY-MM (default: from the inputs)

args.name: top_untagged
args.description: How many untagged resources to list in the tag-coverage section

scripts.name: render_report
scripts.description: Renders report data into a self-contained HTML file with inlined CSS and no external dependencies.

args.name: report_data
args.description: report_data_{YYYY-MM}.json from compose_report_data

args.name: output_dir
args.description: Directory the HTML report is written to (default: output)

args.name: output
args.description: Explicit output path (overrides --output-dir)

args.name: optimization_file
args.description: Optional optimization_signals_*.json; adds the exploratory section. Absent or unreadable, the report is byte-identical to the core report

args.name: template
args.description: Jinja2 template for the report (default: cloudcost/templates/report.html.j2)

args.name: pdf
args.description: Also write a PDF beside the HTML (needs wkhtmltopdf; the HTML never does)

scripts.name: _normalized
scripts.description: Shared vocabulary for canonical resource types, states, and schema-level fields across adapters and detection stages. Import-only module, not a CLI: running it is a no-op.
